T: Not even supposed to be here today. Stayed for dinner.
D: A convenience store clerk called in on his day off has a very long shift.
P: Serve the mains when Veronica turns up at the counter with lasagne for Dante.
S: Twelve deviled eggs with Dijon, paprika and chives
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks mashed with mayo, mustard and a dash of vinegar, piped back in, a dusting of paprika on top, twelve perfect halves.
Quick Stop chips with nacho cheese
Chips with hot cheddar cheese sauce and pickled jalapeños

Warm salted corn chips with a hot, smooth cheddar nacho cheese sauce spiked with pickled jalapeño, served in a paper boat like the store counter. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and cook 1 minute. Whisk in 300ml milk and simmer until thick. Take off the heat and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth, then add 2 tbsp chopped pickled jalapenos, a splash of the pickling liquid and half a tsp smoked paprika. Warm 300g corn chips at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve the chips with the hot cheese for dunking.
the hockey game on the store roof

Soft pretzel knots dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with a sharp two-mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll into ropes and tie into knots. Dip each in 2L boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with wholegrain mustard and a little hot English mustard mixed together.
M: the lasagne Veronica brings to the store

Beef ragù simmered slowly with tomato and red wine, layered with lasagne sheets, lemony ricotta and mozzarella, baked bubbling and rested before cutting. Brown 800g beef mince with an onion and 3 garlic cloves. Add 150ml red wine, 2 cans crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 2 hours. Mix 500g ricotta with an egg, 50g parmesan, lemon zest and parsley. In a dish, layer ragù, 300g lasagne sheets and ricotta three times, finishing with ragù and 250g mozzarella. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes and rest 20 minutes before cutting.
Salami, ham and provolone with lettuce, tomato, onion, oil and red wine vinegar
Long rolls loaded with salami, ham, provolone, shredded lettuce, tomato, onion, oil, vinegar and oregano, wrapped tight and cut in half.
W: Chocolate sponge rectangles sandwiched with marshmallow buttercream

Little chocolate sponge cakes split and filled with fluffy vanilla marshmallow cream, then dipped in a glossy chocolate coat with a white icing squiggle. Whisk 3 eggs and 100g caster sugar until thick, fold in 70g self-raising flour and 20g cocoa and bake in a lined slice tin at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool and cut into 12 rectangles. Beat 100g soft butter, 150g icing sugar, 100g marshmallow fluff and vanilla until fluffy. Sandwich pairs of cake with it. Dip in 150g dark chocolate melted with 50ml cream and pipe a white icing squiggle on top.
K: Chocolate malted milkshake with vanilla ice cream and crushed malt balls

Cold milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, cocoa and malted milk powder, poured into tall glasses with crushed malt balls on top. Put 600ml cold milk, 4 big scoops of vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp malted milk powder in a blender. Blend until thick and frothy. Pour into four tall chilled glasses. Crush a handful of chocolate malt balls in a bag with a rolling pin and scatter over the top. Serve with a straw.
